title: Ecology
subtitle: Who lives where, and why
summary: How many kinds of living things there are, why no population grows for ever, and what happens when you take a predator away. Each lesson opens on a real puzzle (an island of starving reindeer, a drought on a Galápagos rock, a beach where one man threw sea stars into the sea) and follows the people who worked it out, with live models you can run. Carbon and nitrogen cycles, succession, islands and losing species are to come.
